title: Primary Frostbite
summary: Primary Frostbite is an Arcane Enhancement for primary weapons that increases primary weapon critical multiplier and multishot for 12 seconds when applying  Cold procs.
extract:
Primary Frostbite is an Arcane Enhancement for primary weapons that increases primary weapon critical multiplier and multishot for 12 seconds when applying  Cold procs.

Effect

Acquisition
Primary Frostbite can be obtained from Conjunction Survival Circulus on Lua as a Rotation C reward.
Purchaseable from Archimedean Yonta for 15  Lua Thrax Plasm each, with a total of 315 for max rank.
Possible reward from Deepmines Bounties from Nightcap.
Purchaseable from Nightcap in Fortuna for 10  Fergolyte each, with a total of 210 for max rank.

All drop rates data is obtained from DE's official drop tables stored on Module:DropTables/data.
See Mission Rewards#Standard Missions for definitions on reward table rotations.
For more detailed definitions and information,
visit here.

Notes
At every rank, it will take 40  Cold procs to reach the maximum bonus.
Stacking the Frostbite buff does not require the  Cold proc to come from the attached primary weapon. It can come from any source, even while the primary is holstered, including:
Any weapon with modded or innate  Cold damage and status chance
Warframe abilities including the following:
Warframes with abilities that directly inflict  Cold status effects, such as  Frost,  Yareli, and  Gauss
Warframes with  Cold-moddable Exalted Weapons, such as  Cyte-09,  Temple, and  Ivara and others
Warframes which have received subsume abilities from the Helminth that can inflict  Cold including:
 Ice Wave from  Frost
 Vial Rush from  Lavos
 Thermal Sunder from  Gauss
Warframes with abilities that apply many status effects, such as  Citrine,  Koumei and  Voruna
Warframes with variable-element configurations, such as  Lavos and  Chroma
Warframes that make  Cold-inflicting traps, such as  Follie and  Mirage
Performing a dodge-roll with  Melee Careen creates 1 stack of Frostbite per enemy frozen
Any  Cold status procs inflicted by Companion via modded weapons and abilities, such  Coolant Leak and  Aerial Bond
Stacks are granted and refreshed even on fatal damage instances that apply  Cold.
Though some enemies have a capped number of status effects they can receive, such as Bosses and Adversaries (usually capped at 4 stacks), applying a  Cold proc to a non-Frozen enemy at max procs will still cause Frostbite to refresh and stack.
However, fully Frozen enemies (10 stacks of  Cold) cannot receive a new Cold proc, and do not have any interaction with Frostbite until the 3-second Freeze wears off.
 Ice Spring does not stack Frostbite, despite inflicting a  Cold status proc.
If the 12 second timer expires without applying a fresh  Cold status effect, all stacks are removed.
This behavior is consistent with other weapon arcanes that trigger on status effect application, like  Primary Blight and  Cascadia Flare.
This is distinct from weapon arcanes that trigger on kill, like  Primary Merciless and  Primary Deadhead, where timer expiration causes only one stack to be removed at a time.
At Rank 5 with maximum stacks, Primary Frostbite gives the same stat bonus as  Vital Sense and  Split Chamber combined.
 Primary Blight, a primary weapon arcane with similar effects except triggered by  Toxin, can be compared to Frostbite, and both weapon arcanes yield very effective damage boosts with only slight differences.
 Primary Frostbite, triggering on  Cold, offers a maximum 120% Critical Damage and 90% Multishot, prioritizing Multishot.
 Primary Blight, triggering from  Toxin, offers a maximum 144% Critical Damage and 72% Multishot, prioritizing Critical Damage.
However,  Primary Frostbite has advantages over  Primary Blight, since the Frostbite buff can be stacked with  Cold status effects from any source, whereas  Primary Blight can only be stacked from primary weapon  Toxin status effects.

Tips
With high fire rate weapons such as  Glaxion ( Vandal,  Tenet),  Verglas, or  Tazicor, Primary Frostbite's max stack can be reached quickly (especially if supplemented by  Shivering Contagion).
 Lavos ability  Vial Rush and  Transmutation Probe is an effective way to get this arcane to max stacks quickly, as those abilities proc repeatedly over time and cover a large area.
Effects that passively inflict  Cold status procs on enemies in an AoE around the player are helpful for acquiring and keeping stacks, such as  Melee Careen,  Aerial Bond, and  Coolant Leak.
In particular  Coolant Leak applies  Cold in a radius on a 10-second cooldown, allowing for persistent upkeep of Frostbite's 12-second buff so long as enemies are nearby.

Bugs
If installed in the primary arcane slot of an Archgun equipped in the Heavy Weapon slot (on the third page of the Arsenal screen, below Gear and Emotes wheels), applying  Cold status effects will cause the buff icon to appear even while that weapon is not equipped.
However, the effects are not applied to any weapon unless  Primary Frostbite is installed in that weapon's active arcane slot.
